config.label: GitLab personal access token for local stdio use
config.description: GitLab personal access token for local stdio use. A non-empty value overrides GITLAB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN_FILE. One of this token, GITLAB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN_FILE, GITLAB_JOB_TOKEN, GITLAB_AUTH_COOKIE_PATH, or GITLAB_USE_OAUTH=true must be set. Create a token with the GitLab scopes the tools need, such as api or read_api.

config.label: Path to a file that contains the personal access token
config.description: Path to a file that contains the personal access token. Read once at startup and trimmed. Ignored when GITLAB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN or --token is non-empty. A missing, unreadable, or empty file stops startup. Does not replace job token, OAuth, cookie, or remote authorization.

config.label: Optional GitLab CI job token to use instead of a personal access token when running inside GitLab CI
config.description: Optional GitLab CI job token to use instead of a personal access token when running inside GitLab CI.

config.label: Optional path to a GitLab authentication cookie file for cookie-based authentication
config.description: Optional path to a GitLab authentication cookie file for cookie-based authentication.

config.label: Set to true to start with GitLab OAuth instead of a personal access token, job token, or cookie file
config.description: Set to true to start with GitLab OAuth instead of a personal access token, job token, or cookie file.

config.label: GitLab OAuth application ID
config.description: GitLab OAuth application ID. When GITLAB_USE_OAUTH=true, set this or GITLAB_OAUTH_TOKEN_SCRIPT.

config.label: Command that prints an OAuth access token
config.description: Command that prints an OAuth access token. When GITLAB_USE_OAUTH=true, set this or GITLAB_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID.

config.label: GitLab API base URL
config.description: GitLab API base URL. Use https://gitlab.com/api/v4 for GitLab.com or your self-managed GitLab API URL.

config.label: Optional comma-separated list of GitLab project IDs that this server is allowed to access
config.description: Optional comma-separated list of GitLab project IDs that this server is allowed to access.

config.label: Tool exposure
config.description: Tool exposure. Allowed values are readonly, modify, and full. Unset uses full. readonly keeps read-only tools. modify blocks delete and teardown tools.

config.label: Optional comma-separated list of toolsets to enable, such as projects, issues, merge_requests, pipelines, releases, users, groups, wiki, or search
config.description: Optional comma-separated list of toolsets to enable, such as projects, issues, merge_requests, pipelines, releases, users, groups, wiki, or search.

config.description: Optional comma-separated list of individual tool names to add on top of enabled toolsets.

config.description: Optional regular expression used to hide matching tools from the server.

config.description: Optional comma-separated list of tool names that require explicit approval before execution.

config.description: Optional comma-separated list of tool names to hide from tools/list.
